request.style: English, solemn female soprano solo with gentle choir backing, harp, strings, piano, soft flute, reverent and hopeful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I thank my God each time
That you come to my mind
In every prayer I lift
For all of you combined

[Verse]
With joy I do remember
Your partnership in grace
From the first day until now
You share this holy place

[Chorus]
He who began a good work in you
Will bring it to completion
Until the day of Christ Jesus
His faithful preservation

[Verse]
It is right for me to think
Of all of you with care
I hold you in my heart
Beyond comparison there

[Chorus]
He who began a good work in you
Will bring it to completion
Until the day of Christ Jesus
His faithful preservation

[Bridge]
Whether in chains or defending
Confirming the gospel way
You share with me in this grace
That I can never sway

[Outro]
God is my witness how I long
With the affection of Christ
Your love will overflow
In knowledge and in light
